en.headline: Customs seizes 250000 illicit cigarettes in Fanling, arrests five men
en.dek: Officers found the cigarettes in vehicles at Wah Ming Estate on Thursday, with a market value of about HK$1.1 million; the five men aged 30 to 55 have been charged.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two illicit cigarette cases at Wah Ming Estate in Fanling on Thursday, seizing about 250,000 suspected illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of about HK$1.1 million and a duty value of about HK$820,000.

Acting on intelligence, officers spotted two men moving suspected illicit cigarettes from a private car to a truck. They stopped the men and found about 110,000 cigarettes in the two vehicles, arresting them. During the investigation, officers stopped another private car nearby and found about 140,000 cigarettes, arresting three men inside.

Customs believes the syndicate used the public housing estate as a distribution point to repackage and supply the cigarettes across districts. The five arrested men, aged between 30 and 55, have been charged. The investigation continues, with officers tracing the source and destination of the cigarettes and not ruling out further arrests.

Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, dealing with, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment. Customs said it would continue multi-level enforcement against illicit cigarette activities.

zh.headline: 海關粉嶺華明邨破兩宗私煙案 檢獲約25萬支拘5男
zh.dek: 關員周四在華明邨發現涉案車輛，檢獲懷疑私煙市值約110萬元，五名30至55歲男子已被起訴。
body: 香港海關周四在粉嶺華明邨偵破兩宗私煙案件，共檢獲約25萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約110萬元，應課稅值約82萬元。
關員根據情報分析，發現兩名男子正從私家車搬運懷疑私煙到貨車，隨即截停並在兩輛車內檢獲約11萬支，將兩人拘捕。調查期間，關員在附近截停另一輛私家車，檢獲約14萬支，再拘捕車上三名男子。
海關相信不法集團利用該公共屋邨作為分發點，進行包裝及供應私煙至不同地區。五名被捕男子年齡介乎30至55歲，已被落案起訴。調查仍在進行，關員正追查私煙來源及目的地，不排除有進一步拘捕。
根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙即屬違法，一經定罪最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。海關表示會繼續從不同層面打擊私煙活動。
